headline: Diesel hits all-time record as crack spreads keep pump prices elevated
intro: Labor Day usually means road-trip season winding down — instead it delivered the priciest gas and diesel Americans have ever seen at the pump. Refining margins are doing a lot of the heavy lifting here, and EIA just spelled out exactly why.
overview: Retail gasoline and diesel both notched record highs over the Labor Day weekend, with diesel topping $5.90/gal amid tight distillate stocks ahead of harvest season, while EIA attributes elevated pump prices largely to gasoline crack spreads running about $1/gal above 2025 levels on tight global gasoline supply. Geopolitics continues to threaten refined product supply chains: Ukraine struck additional Russian refineries in Perm and Tatarstan, Houthi drones hit Saudi Aramco's Jazan refinery, and renewed US-Iran tensions kept Hormuz risk premiums in crude and diesel elevated. On policy, the House committee advanced the Diesel Emissions Reduction Act, EPA's small-refinery exemptions are drawing pushback from Iowa's biofuel industry, and Montana Renewables revised its renewable diesel/SAF expansion plans.

stories.title: Elevated crack spreads and crude oil prices contribute to higher prices at the pump
stories.summary: EIA explains that gasoline crack spreads in New York Harbor have averaged about $1/gal higher than 2025 since May, driven primarily by tight global gasoline supplies, directly contributing to elevated pump prices.

stories.title: Gas prices at record high for any Labor Day, as diesel hits all-time record
stories.summary: Average regular gas hit a record $4.15/gal for any Labor Day, while diesel hit an all-time record of $5.90/gal, per AAA data.

stories.title: Labor Day weekend gas prices have never been higher
stories.summary: Labor Day weekend gas prices have never been higher, with regular unleaded averaging $4.15/gal nationwide, according to a fuel analyst.

stories.title: The U.S. gas average is $4.14 a gallon, but diesel is even more expensive
stories.summary: US average regular gas sits at $4.14/gal, but diesel is running even higher, with knock-on effects for prices of goods that move by truck.

stories.title: The price of diesel is showing up in the price of almost everything
stories.summary: Diesel's record-high price is showing up in costs across the economy, as truckers and businesses at an Alabama truck stop describe passing costs through.

stories.title: Fuel prices at record Labor Day high in US thanks to Iran War and refinery issues
stories.summary: Regular gas averaged $4.14/gal heading into Labor Day, nearly a dollar above last year and well past the prior 2012 holiday-weekend record, with the piece citing Iran conflict and refinery issues as drivers.

stories.title: USA Retail Diesel Hits Record
stories.summary: US retail diesel rose to a fresh record high, per the latest data.

stories.title: Ukraine Restarts Attacks on Refineries Deep Inside Russia
stories.summary: Ukraine says it struck oil processing plants in Russia's Perm region and Tatarstan overnight, resuming attacks on refineries deep inside Russian territory.

stories.title: Zelensky Says Ukrainian Drones Struck Russian Oil Refineries, Drone Depot, Military Targets
stories.summary: Zelensky says Ukrainian drones struck Russian oil refineries, a drone depot, and military targets, with Russia claiming to have intercepted 306 drones overnight.

stories.title: Saudi Aramco facility hit in new strikes amid regional tensions
stories.summary: Houthi drone strikes hit Saudi Aramco's Jazan refinery for the second time in two weeks, escalating threats to regional refining infrastructure.

stories.title: Oil Holds Gains
stories.summary: Oil ended a volatile week 9.7% higher as renewed US-Iran fighting kept Hormuz supply risk elevated, a key driver behind the crude and product price moves.

stories.title: ATA applauds House committee’s passage of Diesel Emissions Reduction Act
stories.summary: The House committee passed the technology-neutral Diesel Emissions Reduction Act of 2025, which now heads to the full House.

stories.title: Iowa biofuel industry presses EPA after refinery exemptions
stories.summary: Iowa biofuel producers are pressing EPA to quickly restore renewable fuel demand after the agency granted 29 refineries full or partial small-refinery exemptions.

stories.title: Montana Renewables revises expansion plans
stories.summary: Montana Renewables has revised its Phase 2 expansion plans, opting not to draw the full $658 million in approved federal loan capital for its renewable diesel/SAF buildout.
